name: @pipeworx/mcp-geo

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Convert an address or place name to up to 5 matching coordinates via OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Returns latitude, longitude, display_name, and place type for each result.

query.description: Address or place name to geocode

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Convert coordinates to a physical address. Returns street address, city, country, and postal code. Use to identify locations from lat/lng pairs.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Get country information by name or ISO code (e.g., 'US', 'FR'). Returns capital, population, currency, languages, and neighboring countries. Use for regional context or facts.

code_or_name.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3 code

tools.name: get_timezone
tools.description: Look up the IANA timezone name, current local time, and UTC offset (hours) for a given latitude and longitude via TimeAPI.io. Requires coordinates — does not accept city names.

tools.name: get_sunrise_sunset
tools.description: Fetch sunrise, sunset, solar noon, civil twilight begin/end, and day length (seconds) for a given latitude/longitude on an optional YYYY-MM-DD date (defaults to today) via the Sunrise-Sunset API.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-geo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the geo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
